import json
import sqrt2_power_exp_uniform_witness as p
from sqrt2_power_definitions import parse_named
from peano_lab.library.proof_bundle import encode_formula
registry=p.definition_registry();encoded=encode_formula(parse_named(p.NAMED_SOURCE,registry=registry))
found={}
for pin in p.ARCHIVES:
    rows=p.read_mixed_archive(pin)
    for name,source in p.ENDPOINT_SOURCES.items():
        if p.ENDPOINT_OWNERS[name]!=pin['case']:continue
        exact=encode_formula(parse_named(source,registry=registry))
        matches=[i for i,row in enumerate(rows) if row[1]==exact]
        assert len(matches)==1 and rows[matches[0]][3]
        found[name]=(pin['case'],matches[0])
assert len(found)==len(p.ENDPOINT_SOURCES)
print(json.dumps(dict(target_sha256=p.json_hash(encoded),target_bytes=len(p.canonical(encoded)),definitions=len(registry),source_pins=len(p.exp_uniform_witness_source_pins()),endpoints=found),sort_keys=True))
